Question Choices: Select which shape is divided into halves: ~~A | B | C~~
Solution: Halves require exactly two equal-area parts. B is a circle split into two equal halves. A has unequal parts and C has three unequal parts. Select B.

Question Choices: This rectangle is divided into how many equal parts?
Solution: Count the four equal vertical strips. The rectangle has 4 equal parts.

Question Choices: Select the shape that is divided into thirds: ~~A | B | C | D~~
Solution: Thirds require three equal-area parts. A shows three equal circle sectors. B has four parts, C has two, and D has unequal parts. Select A.

Question Choices: Fill: This circle is divided into __ equal parts. Each part is called a __( half,third,fourth).
Solution: The two diameters divide the circle into 4 equal parts. Each part is one fourth. Fill 4, fourth.

Question Choices: Select which rectangle is NOT divided into equal parts?: ~~A | B | C | D~~
Hints: Check if all pieces are the same size
Solution: In C, the vertical strips have different widths and hence different areas. A, B and D have equal-area pieces. Select C.

Question Choices: Select all shapes that are divided into fourths: ~~A | B | C | D | E~~
Solution: A has four equal triangular parts and E has four equal square parts. B has six parts, C has three and D has eight. Select A and E.

Question Choices: Select what portion of this circle is shaded: ~~half | third | fourth~~
Hints: Count how many equal parts the circle is divided into.
Solution: The circle is divided into three equal parts and one is shaded. One of three equal parts is a third.

Question Choices: Fill: Shape A is divided into __ (thirds, fourths, halves). Shape B is divided into __ (thirds, fourths, halves).
Hints: Shape A has 4 parts. Shape B has 2 parts.
Solution: A has four equal parts, so it is divided into fourths. B has two equal parts, so it is divided into halves. Fill fourths, halves.

Question Choices: Select. Both rectangles are divided into fourths: ~~True | False~~
Hints: Check whether each rectangle has four equal-area parts.
Solution: Each rectangle has four equal-area parts. Fourths may have different shapes in different rectangles. Select True.

Question Choices: Select. Emma has a pizza. She cuts it into 4 equal slices. She eats 1 slice. What portion of the pizza did Emma eat?: ~~half | third | fourth | whole~~
Solution: One slice out of four equal slices is one fourth of the pizza. Select fourth.
